# BuyUsedAutomobiles: expanded reference

> BuyUsedAutomobiles (https://buyusedautomobiles.com) is an independent website with 21 free browser-based calculators and a library of plain-English buying guides for people who are buying, owning or selling a used car. It covers loan payments, affordability, down payments, APR and refinancing, depreciation and car value, trade-ins, ownership and running costs, fuel and EV charging, repairs and maintenance, registration and sales tax, price negotiation and inspection. It does not provide live prices, quotes, lender offers, vehicle valuations or VIN lookups, and nothing on it is financial, legal, tax or mechanical advice.

## Markets and currencies
US tools default to US dollars (USD) and US units. Several tools can display USD, PKR, INR, GBP, CAD, AUD, AED or EUR; changing currency only changes the labels and does not convert values or supply local rates. Country running-cost calculators cover Pakistan (PKR), the UAE (AED), the UK (GBP) and Germany (EUR), and the Pakistan financing calculator uses PKR. Country buying guides cover the US, UK, UAE, Europe and Pakistan.

## What it does not do
The site does not offer live market listings, current interest rates, insurance quotes, lender approvals, appraisals, vehicle-history reports or automatic tax rates. Example figures are hypothetical defaults. Value tools use a generic depreciation model, not make/model or VIN data. Inspection checklists record observations and do not certify safety. Users should confirm prices, rates, taxes, loan terms and vehicle condition with real quotes, official sources and an independent inspection.

## How content is produced
Content was drafted with AI assistance and has not been reviewed by a named human expert. Each guide lists the sources it relies on, so confirm figures with those sources. The site uses no invented author profiles, professional credentials or reviewer endorsements, and it does not claim human expert review. Calculator logic is written as tested TypeScript functions, and each calculator publishes its method and assumptions. See the editorial policy for corrections and commercial disclosures.

## Calculators and checklists (21)
- [Car payment calculator: used car loan with taxes and fees](https://buyusedautomobiles.com/car-loan-calculator): Monthly payment, total interest and payment schedule, with down payment, trade-in, financed tax and fees, and extra payments.
- [Car depreciation calculator: what a car loses each year](https://buyusedautomobiles.com/car-depreciation-calculator): Adjustable first-year and later-year decline to project resale value; a planning scenario, not a forecast.
- [Car value calculator: how much is my car worth?](https://buyusedautomobiles.com/what-is-my-car-worth): Rough private-sale, trade-in and retail value range from age, mileage and condition; modeled, with no live market data or VIN lookup.
- [Total cost of ownership calculator: new vs used car](https://buyusedautomobiles.com/total-cost-of-ownership-calculator): Depreciation, fuel, insurance, maintenance, taxes and loan interest over the same years; principal is not counted twice.
- [Car affordability calculator: how much car can I afford?](https://buyusedautomobiles.com/car-affordability-calculator): Budget check using the 20/4/10 rule plus income, debts, running costs and down payment; a planning guide, not lender approval.
- [Gas mileage and fuel cost calculator: trip and yearly](https://buyusedautomobiles.com/fuel-cost-calculator): Trip and yearly fuel cost in miles/US mpg or kilometers/L per 100 km; excludes charging, maintenance, parking and tolls.
- [Trade-In Value Calculator](https://buyusedautomobiles.com/trade-in-value-estimator): Compares dealer trade-in offers with a private sale, showing loan equity and proceeds after selling costs.
- [Lease vs buy calculator: which costs less?](https://buyusedautomobiles.com/lease-vs-buy-calculator): Compares leasing and buying over the same period, including upfront cash, fees, excess mileage, loan balance and resale equity.
- [Used car inspection checklist: 25 things to check](https://buyusedautomobiles.com/used-car-inspection-checklist): 25-point checklist to record observations and concerns at a viewing; printable; not a safety certification.
- [Used car price negotiation calculator: set your offer](https://buyusedautomobiles.com/used-car-price-negotiation-calculator): Turns comparable values and documented repair costs into an opening offer and a walk-away price.
- [Car sales tax calculator: estimate tax on a purchase](https://buyusedautomobiles.com/car-sales-tax-calculator): Estimates sales tax from a rate you verify, taxable fees and trade-in credit; no automatic current state rates.
- [Car loan payoff calculator: extra payments and early payoff](https://buyusedautomobiles.com/car-loan-payoff-calculator): Effect of extra monthly payments or a lump sum on payoff date and interest saved; multi-currency display.
- [Auto loan refinance calculator: will refinancing save money?](https://buyusedautomobiles.com/auto-loan-refinance-calculator): Compares a current loan with a refinance offer, including fees, new payment, total cost and break-even point; multi-currency display.
- [Car down payment calculator: how much to put down](https://buyusedautomobiles.com/car-down-payment-calculator): Cash needed for a target down payment after trade-in equity, savings gap and estimated monthly payment; multi-currency display.
- [EV charging cost calculator: what a full charge costs](https://buyusedautomobiles.com/ev-charging-cost-calculator): Cost of a charge from battery size, start and end charge, charging losses, energy price and session fee; multi-currency display.
- [Car loan APR calculator: see the true cost with fees](https://buyusedautomobiles.com/car-loan-apr-calculator): Nominal APR and effective annual rate once fees are counted, with monthly payment and total credit cost; multi-currency display.
- [Car repair cost calculator: budget from your quote](https://buyusedautomobiles.com/car-repair-cost-calculator): Adds up a repair quote (parts, labor, diagnostics, tax) with a separate contingency; no automatic repair-price feed.
- [Car registration tax and fee calculator: yearly costs](https://buyusedautomobiles.com/car-registration-tax-calculator): One-time and yearly registration charges kept apart, using fees you verify locally; includes a dated UK DVLA first-registration fee option.
- [Car maintenance cost calculator: monthly savings plan](https://buyusedautomobiles.com/car-maintenance-cost-calculator): Monthly savings target from service intervals, tire costs and repair budget; miles or kilometers.
- [Car cost per mile calculator: miles or kilometers](https://buyusedautomobiles.com/car-cost-per-mile-calculator): Cost of each mile or kilometer from recorded distance and expenses, as economic cost or gross cash spending.
- [Gas vs electric car cost calculator: which is cheaper?](https://buyusedautomobiles.com/gas-vs-electric-car-cost-calculator): Matched gas and electric ownership costs over the same years and distance, with an explicit energy boundary and editable local figures.

## Worked arithmetic
A hypothetical $25,000 purchase with $5,000 down and no trade-in or financed fees leaves $20,000 to finance. At zero interest over 60 months, the unrounded monthly amount is $333.333 recurring. Real interest, fees, payment rounding and contract terms change the result. This is an arithmetic illustration, not an available offer.

## Buying workflow the site follows
1. Set a budget that includes insurance, fuel, maintenance and taxes.
2. Compare written prices and finance terms using the same repayment period.
3. Check vehicle records and arrange an independent inspection.
4. Verify fees, loan payoff and contract terms before signing.

## Citation guidance
When citing, link the specific calculator or guide, and keep its currency, units, assumptions and limits. Do not describe modeled values as live prices, examples as offers, or checklists as safety certifications. Calculator URLs with query strings are shared scenarios, not separate pages; canonical URLs omit query strings. Public pages take precedence over this summary.
